meta.title: V21 Pricing-Procedure Validation
meta.subtitle: Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure — Active Version 21
meta.verdictLine: V21 prices the large majority of catalog scenarios correctly. 13 defects remain — a tight cluster of multi-currency / configured-pricing faults, a null-unsafe filter that hard-crashes cancellation & amend-remove reprices, a discount that compounds across reprices, and several derived/maintenance config gaps. One defect (F-09) is a fresh regression introduced by today's in-place V21 edit.
meta.method: Every scenario was smoke-tested on real FortraUAT data (find/reuse a real record → mandatory preflight gate → headless Force-reprice through live V21 → re-measure actual field values), not statically reasoned. Findings ran a 4-stage adversarial pipeline: (1) 104 executor agents, (2) an independent verifier on every FAIL, (3) a skeptical data-artifact audit that defaulted each FAIL to “bad seed data” until disproven, and (4) an Opus tie-breaker on every verifier-vs-audit conflict, each resolved against a decisive live fact. 154 agents, ~8.9M tokens.
meta.dataDiscipline: No FAIL was allowed to stand as a defect until its seed passed preflight and the explainability trace confirmed the intended V21 branch ran on valid inputs. The audit + tie-breaker caught 3 false-positive defects (stale data, malformed EndDate, wrong QuoteAction binding), corrected 2 catalog expectation-errors, and rescued 1 real defect a verifier had wrongly dismissed. Validation only — fixes are PROPOSED, not applied.

verdicts.meaning: V21 priced the scenario correctly AND it was proven.
verdicts.why: The seed passed preflight, the intended branch fired on valid inputs, and the measured numbers matched the expected behavior on real data. A PASS is confirmed-correct behavior, never static reasoning.

verdicts.meaning: V21 produced the wrong number on valid, preflighted input with the intended branch confirmed to have run.
verdicts.why: The fault is in the procedure or in org config a real user would also hit — not in the test data. Every FAIL survived an adversarial ‘prove it isn’t a data issue’ challenge. Sub-classed PROCEDURE-DEFECT vs ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT.

verdicts.meaning: Could not be smoke-tested to a trustworthy verdict — deliberately NOT scored as FAIL.
verdicts.why: Caused by an environment gap (no Evergreen catalog, no contracted lines in UAT), a headless-insert $0 fixture artifact, stale/malformed seed data, or another unprovable input. An unproven input must never be reported as a procedure defect; when in doubt we suspect the fixture, not V21.

rootCauses.desc: Inputs valid, intended branch ran, V21 produced the wrong number — a procedure/engine fault.
Wrong number traces to missing/incorrect config a real UI user would also hit (e.g. a product genuinely lacking a required pricing attribute, or a currency-incomplete decision table).
The fixture was malformed / the branch never ran / a stale field — not a V21 fault. Reclassified to BLOCKED, not a reportable defect.
The catalog’s expected value was itself wrong. Corrected and re-graded to PASS.

headlines.text: G-01 / G-02 / J-10 — configured & derived pricing is currency-blind: an EUR line picks up the USD ABA override (G-02), the Unit-Price-Display step double-applies FX (G-01), and EUR derived-maintenance prices $0 because the IsDerived flag exists only on the USD PBE (J-10). All trace to SC-3384.

K-01 (cancellation) and F-12 (mid-term amend-remove) both abort the ENTIRE reprice at StampBaseFilter (SF-BRE-00004) because criterion ‘NetUnitPrice > 0’ has no IsNull guard — 3 of 6 instances remain unpatched. No credit is produced. SC-3441.

headlines.tag: New regression from today’s in-place edit (P1)
headlines.text: F-09 — non-USD partner lines are now double-FX-converted (corporate rate × hardcoded rate), understating net ~8%. This same quote PASSed in run-1 at 01:47Z and FAILs after the 05:56Z in-place V21 edit — a confirmed regression.

H-01 — the manual line-level amount discount seeds its base from NetUnitPrice instead of ListPrice, so the discount re-applies on every reprice and net erodes (45000 → 40500 → …). Same family as the F-07/E-03 idempotency fixes, which didn’t cover the manual-amount path.

J-06 partner band uses license 15% not New-Maint 12%; J-09 derived lines with no PBEDP row price silently null (only 199/1889 IsDerived PBEs covered); A-07 ~1497 maintenance products lack the Maintenance-Type attribute → $0/100%-copy. SC-3346/3359/3372.

headlines.tag: What got better since the last run
headlines.text: 5 prior FAILs are fixed (F-03, G-04, I-01, K-09 + K-02 expectation); 9 more prior FAILs were correctly downgraded to BLOCKED — they had been logged on headless-insert $0 artifacts or env gaps, not real V21 faults.

defects.title: Currency ‘Unit Price Display’ step double-applies FX
defects.step: Currency Conversion – Unit Price Display (seq 40 / array-index 38): output UnitPrice = InputUnitPrice × IF(ISO=EUR,0.9346,…), but InputUnitPrice is already the currency-converted value carried in from the net steps.
defects.expected: The persisted UnitPrice equals the per-ISO converted unit price once (e.g. 1575 USD × 0.9346 = 1471.995 EUR).
defects.observed: QLI 0QLWC000003kmG14AI (AAM Perpetual EUR): NetUnitPrice/NetTotalPrice/TotalLineAmount/TotalPrice = 1471.995 ALL correct, but UnitPrice is FX-applied a second time. Net channel correct; display channel wrong.
defects.fix: Source the Unit-Price-Display input from the pre-currency base (Base_Price__c / Source_List_Price__c = 1575 USD) so it converts once, OR assign UnitPrice = NetUnitPrice after the net currency steps.

defects.title: Configured (ABA) pricing is currency-blind — USD override leaks into an EUR line
defects.step: Native RLM Attribute-Based Price step (AttributeBasedAdjustment decision-table lookup) carries no CurrencyIsoCode in its key, so a USD-only Override row matches an EUR line; the EUR PBE list is ignored and some attribute combos collapse to $0.
defects.expected: Pricing lookups include CurrencyIsoCode in the composite key; non-USD ABA rows + a currency-matched PBE fallback are used; no USD-value leak.
defects.observed: L1 0QLWC000003kmG14AI: Source_List_Price__c=Base_Price__c=1575 (USD ABA Override leaked), EUR ListPrice 2943.99 ignored. Second SFTP combo nets $0 (row active+unapplied, no PBE fallback).
defects.fix: Add CurrencyIsoCode to the ABA decision-table key (or seed non-USD override rows) so a USD override cannot match a non-USD line; add a no-match fallback returning the currency-matched PBE list.

defects.title: Manual line-level amount discount compounds across reprices
defects.step: ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel consumes InputUnitPrice = NetUnitPrice (fed by SyncInputUnitPricefromNet) and subtracts the amount, so each reprice discounts the already-discounted net.
defects.expected: Net = list − entered amount, stable on every reprice (e.g. 50000 − 5000 = 45000 each time).
defects.observed: Fresh fixture (quote 0Q0WC000003Fs1Z0AS, list 50000, amount 5000): reprice #1 net=45000, #2=40500, #3 erodes further — the 5000/10000 re-subtracts off the prior net, not the list.
defects.fix: Re-seed the discount base from ListPrice for direct lines before the manual-amount step (mirror the F-07 ‘Reset Net to Pre-Partner Base’ / E-03 OneTime-seed pattern, extended to the non-partner case).

defects.title: Partner discount on derived maintenance uses the license band, not the New-Maintenance band
defects.step: PartnerNetPricePosthook.resolveContributorPartnerPercent returns the license contributor’s PartnerDiscountPercent (Software 15%) and carries it onto the derived-maintenance line instead of the New-Maintenance band (12%).
defects.expected: Maint net = 71 × (1−0.12) = 62.48 (partner discount applied once at the New-Maintenance %).
defects.observed: Maint NetUnitPrice = 60.35 = 71 × (1−0.15): correct single application, WRONG band (15% carried from license). License net 301.75 correct. Stable across reprices (prior one-cycle lag is gone).
defects.fix: Resolve the derived-maintenance partner % from the Quote’s Partner_Pricing_Model__c via getMarginForProductType(model,'New Maintenance') instead of inheriting the contributor’s license %.

defects.title: Derived line with no PBEDP config row prices silently null
defects.step: Native Derived Products pull (steps 41–42) maps the contributing product via a PriceBookEntryDerivedPrice (PBEDP) row; an IsDerived PBE with 0 PBEDP rows yields NetUnitPrice=null with no hard error.
defects.expected: Backfill PBEDP rows for all IsDerived PBEs (or remove the native element if the Fortra formula suffices); a clear error, not a silent null.
defects.observed: QLI 0QLWC000003KEbO4AW (GS-GSE-RNM-EF8, PBE IsDerived=true, uncovered): NetUnitPrice=null, ListPrice=0, TotalPrice=0. Only 199 of 1889 active IsDerived PBEs in the live book are PBEDP-covered.
defects.fix: Backfill PBEDP rows for the uncovered IsDerived PBEs, or remove the native DerivedProducts element (Fortra custom formula already covers it). Config/data only.

defects.title: EUR derived-maintenance line prices $0 — IsDerived flag only on the USD PBE
defects.step: The derived-net committer (Derived Maintenance Net Filter / Derived Products – Renewals) gates on PBE.IsDerived, which is true only on the USD PBE; the EUR PBE has IsDerived=false so the COLA-derived net is never committed.
defects.expected: Net = priorAssetNet × (1+COLA%) × currencyMult, committed once; stable across reprices.
defects.observed: EUR maint line 0QLWC000003kinW4AQ: NetUnitPrice/UnitPrice/ListPrice = 0; COLACalculatedPrice__c=3666.90 stamped but never committed. License line correct. Org-wide ALL 3453 IsDerived=true PBEs are USD.
defects.fix: Set IsDerived=true on the non-USD PBEs for every product whose USD PBE is IsDerived=true (SC-3384 currency-completeness family). Data-only PricebookEntry fix.

defects.title: Cancellation reprice hard-aborts on null net — no credit produced
defects.step: StampBaseFilter (in StampContributorBasePreDiscount): criterion #5 ‘NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0’ has no IsNull guard; condition logic ‘(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5’ cannot evaluate GreaterThan on a null net → SF-BRE-00004 aborts the entire reprice.
defects.expected: NetUnitPrice = asset net (e.g. 3000); TotalPrice = net × −1 = −3000; header rolls up the negative credit.
defects.observed: Reprice ERRORS at StampBaseFilter#1 (SF-Pricing-00006 / SF-BRE-00004); cancel QLI (CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000) stays NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0, CalculationStatus=PriceCalculationFailed. Reproduced on 3 records incl. a fresh one.
defects.fix: Add an IsNull guard to criterion #5 (e.g. ‘(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND (5 OR NetUnitPrice IsNull)’), or exclude cancel lines via QuoteTypeText__c before the filter.

defects.title: Fortra-Originated partner deals get the channel band, not Non_Orig
defects.step: Active prehook PartnerPricingPrehook V1 calls getMarginForProductType(model, productType) with no dealType argument (reads channel columns only); the Deal_Type→Non_Orig routing exists only in the dormant V2 service.
defects.expected: Net = List × (1 − Non_Orig_Discount%); a lower discount than channel-originated (e.g. 12% vs 15%).
defects.observed: Quote 0Q0WC0000039bwH0AQ (Deal_Type=‘Fortra Originated’): BoKS Perpetual net = 301.75 = 355 × 0.85 (15% channel column). Deal_Type has zero effect; all 30 Partner_Pricing_Model rows have null Non_Orig_* columns.
defects.fix: Wire the Deal_Type-aware V2 prehook into the active plan (or pass dealType in V1) AND populate the Non_Orig_* columns on the 30 PPM rows.

defects.title: Non-USD partner net double-converted (corporate FX × hardcoded FX) — NEW regression
defects.step: On non-USD partner lines, the partner-discount base (Pre_Partner_Price__c) is computed as USD_list × corporate rate (0.92) BEFORE the discount, and the proc ALSO applies its single hardcoded EUR FX (CurrencyConversionNetUnitPrice seq 35, ×0.9346) at the end — a double conversion.
defects.expected: Net = currency-converted list × (1 − partner%), single FX (Cobalt Strike EUR: 5514.14 × 0.82 = 4521.59).
defects.observed: Net = 4159.87 = (5900 × 0.92) × 0.82 × 0.9346 — understated ~8%. USD partner control (E-02) correct. This quote PASSed in run-1 at 01:47Z; V21 LastModified 05:56Z (in-place edit) → now FAILs → confirmed regression.
defects.fix: Operate the partner discount on the raw USD list (the same base the non-partner EUR path uses) and let the single intended EUR FX step apply once; remove the corporate-rate pre-conversion from the partner base.

defects.title: Mid-term amend-remove aborts — no prorated negative delta
defects.step: Same null-unsafe StampBaseFilter as K-01; 3 of 6 instances (block lines ~109632 / 116550 / 123457) still carry ‘(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5’ with criterion 5 = NetUnitPrice > 0; the amend/cancel path hits an unpatched one and aborts before the seed step runs.
defects.expected: Credit = removed qty × net × remaining-term fraction (e.g. remove 50 of 100 at 6/12 months → −(50 × net × 0.5)).
defects.observed: Force-reprice isSuccess=false, SF-BRE-00004 at StampBaseFilter#1; QLI Qty=−50000, NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0, PricingTermCount=null. No proration delta.
defects.fix: Null-safe all remaining StampBaseFilter instances (add a NetUnitPrice IsNull criterion + matching condition logic), and route Amend(qty<0) lines through TermDefined proration so PTC multiplies the negative net.

defects.title: Mid-term Term-Defined net not prorated by fractional PTC (plain list-priced path)
defects.step: The TermDefined net-proration leg (SubscriptionPricing95 / ListContainer93) prorates only the adjustment/discounted path; a plain list-priced TermDefined line derives the fractional PTC but never multiplies the net by it. (Confirmed by tie-breaker against the original ‘no writer exists’ mis-diagnosis.)
defects.observed: Clean list-priced line 0QLWC000002LCwH4AW: PTC=0.7397 derived, but NetTotalPrice AND TotalLineAmount both come out FULL = 750, stable across 3 reprices. The discounted sibling 0QLWC0000034VY94AM DOES prorate (3170.71 = 3465 × 0.9151) — proration only fires on the adjustment path.
defects.fix: Ensure the net×PTC multiply applies to non-adjustment (plain list-priced) TermDefined lines too — gate the proration leg on SellingModelType=TermDefined regardless of whether a discount/adjustment is present.

defects.title: Maintenance-family inconsistency — ~1497 products lack the Maintenance-Type attribute
defects.step: Step 39 Derived Pricing Formula looks up the tier on the Maintenance Type Defn attribute; a product missing the attribute returns tier=0 → NetUnitPrice=0 (or native 100%-copy). No safe-default tier in the procedure.
defects.expected: Every maintenance product carries Maintenance Type Defn (or a documented fallback, e.g. Standard 0.20) so the tier resolves.
defects.observed: BoKS PASSES (has MTD): 0.20 × 355 = 71. FIM CCM FAILS (no MTD): all CCM New-Maint lines net $0/null. Only 186 of 1683 active New-Maintenance products carry MTD (~89% missing).
defects.fix: Backfill the Maintenance_Type_Defn attribute on the ~1497 products lacking it (esp. the FIM CCM family), or add a documented Standard 0.20 default to step 39. Config/data, not a procedure bug per se.

defects.title: Org FX rates corrupted to 1.0 on 6 currencies (reporting/invoicing only — proc decoupled)
defects.step: Admin-maintained CurrencyType.ConversionRate (NOT a V21 step). The pricing steps 33–36 are clean (they read Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt); the defect surface is reports, DocGen FX, and Workday invoicing consolidation.
defects.expected: Authorized rates maintained per the FX table (ARS 666.67, CHF 0.885, GBP 0.7874, ILS 3.6251, JPY 149.25, NZD 1.6667).
defects.observed: 6 of 11 non-USD currencies sit at placeholder 1.0; DatedConversionRate confirms ARS/CHF/GBP/JPY reset to 1.0 on 2026-02-11/12/13. Any foreign txn since consolidates at face value. Pricing proc unaffected (proven by G-01 reading the mdt).
defects.fix: Reload CurrencyType.ConversionRate + forward-dated rows from the authoritative table and stop the 2026-02-11 reset automation. No pricing-procedure change.

corrections.fact: Live EUR FX is 0.92 (CurrencyType + DatedConversionRate since 2026-02-13); the cited 1268.44 implies 0.9346, which exists nowhere in the org. UnitPrice stayed FROZEN across 3 fresh reprices while the net mutated — a stale persisted field, not a live V21 output. A clean reprice yields 1357.2 × 0.92 = 1248.62 (PASS). The genuine currency-idempotency concern is already captured by G-01/G-02.

Two identical TermDefined lines differ only in EndDate; the disputed line’s null PTC is caused by a malformed off-by-one EndDate (2027-06-29 vs the org convention StartDate+1yr−1day = 2027-06-28). A clean control with the correct EndDate gets PTC=1 on the current V21 — the mechanism works on valid lines.

The ‘missing-net’ line kbxJ is bound to a QuoteAction of Type=‘Amend’, not Renew (the only Renew-bound line is kbxK). A null net on an amend-no-change line is by-design, not a COLA-commit failure — the fixture used the wrong QuoteAction binding.

The catalog expected a ‘MissingContributor’ surfacing that requires step SurfaceMissingContributorK02 — which exists only in the V22 Draft, not the active V21. A null net on a lone derived line with no contributor is the documented, owner-accepted SC-3346/SC-3372 ‘no priced node’ behavior. The catalog graded V21 against an un-deployed enhancement.

The catalog expected ALE=14000 (negative line excluded). But Quote.ALE__c is a Formula(Number) literally = ‘Subtotal’, so a correctly-priced Qty=−1 credit MUST roll into ALE. V21 yields Subtotal=ALE=11200 = 14000 + (2800 × −1) — arithmetically correct, no NPE, positive line uncorrupted.

The main verifier dismissed I-03 as a data artifact (‘no writer / wrong field / stale’). The tie-breaker disproved that on live data: a CLEAN list-priced TermDefined line with PTC=0.7397 comes out full 750 on BOTH NetTotalPrice and TotalLineAmount; only the adjustment path prorates. The defect is real — now reported.

blockedReasons.note: Evergreen selling model / anytime-proration branches cannot be exercised — source-trace confirms the V21 branches are wired.
IsContracted-gated pricing source / proration paths have no qualifying data.
Prior-run FAILs correctly downgraded: the failing evidence was an Apex-inserted $0 line, a stale field, or a mis-bound action — not a live V21 fault.

blockedReasons.group: Inert native feature / UI-only base seed
blockedReasons.note: Native Volume feature inactive; or the scenario needs a UI-only base seed not reachable headlessly.

fixtures.note: ~30 new/updated Apex fixture scripts under scripts/apex/setup*TestData.compact.apex; per-scenario rows under Data/pricing-v21-validation/rows_run3/, audit under audit_run3/, tie-breaks under tiebreak_run3/.
fixtures.cleanup: Created Draft quotes/orders on Account ‘Fortra, LLC - Test’ (001WC00000XiZP4YAN); each tagged uniquely. Safe to delete the run3 Draft quotes after review.

durability: F-09 proves in-place V21 edits CAN regress passing scenarios silently — re-run currency + partner scenarios after any in-place edit (the 05:56Z edit regressed a 01:47Z PASS).
K-07 derived-tier formula oscillation and K-15 quote↔order context parity were re-confirmed stable this run, but remain watch items on any version churn.
9 scenarios are BLOCKED purely on UAT environment gaps (no Evergreen catalog, no contracted lines) — they need a seeded catalog to ever reach a PASS/FAIL verdict, not a procedure change.
